purpose: Reader-facing map by named result; historical directory names are preserved input identities, not required reading order.
proof_status: Mathematical proofs are read, not executed. Exact polynomial identities and Bernstein coefficients are computational proof steps after the analytic domain reduction. Finite catalogue enumeration is corroboration of declared cases and does not prove all-size statements. The current uniform triangle bound is 12/11; 873/800 and 35/32 certificates remain unchanged historical controls.
input_rule: All listed scripts, data, support texts and expected outputs are hash-bound by frozen_manifest.json. Program-defined finite cases and exact formulas are embedded in the checker source where no separate input is listed.
additional_selected_checks: The retained P24 manifest declares 26 historical programs and 27 outputs. The public adapter reproduces 26 outputs byte-for-byte and one with scientifically identical content and explicitly migrated provenance. Ten added audit/demo checks run through run_all_checks.py. Together with six core scientific programs, the full replay executes 42 scientific program entries and one separately counted malformed-certificate control.
